concepts.quote: Java passes copies of the values, so main's variables do not change
concepts.why: Correctly applies to this code that swap's assignments change only its own local copies, so main's num1 and num2 keep 7 and 42, giving the right main output.
The answer never mentions or traces the assignments (temp = num1; num1 = num2; num2 = temp), so nothing about assignment can be levelled.
The swap result inside the method is correct but given bare, with no trace of the three steps through temp, so it is a bare correct output (L1).
